pages.title: Nether Species
pages.text: These bees can only be acquired in the Nether, either through breeding or by using a $(l:beeindustry:machines/nectar_lure)Nectar Lure$(). They are often resistant to fire.

$(li)Netherrack Bee: Produces Netherrack.$(br)$(li)Quartz Bee: Produces Quartz.$(br)$(li)Bone Bee: Produces Bone Meal.$(br)$(li)Soul Sand Bee: Produces Soul Sand.$(br)$(li)Glowstone Bee: Produces Glowstone Dust.$(br)$(li)Lava Bee: Produces Magma Cream.$(br)$(li)Blaze Bee: Produces Blaze Powder.
